selection: One title excerpt from the official NCBI Disease test corpus, a non-QA BLURB component. Native BLURB tokenization and full-document evaluation are not reproduced.

examples.title: NCBI Disease: identify disease mentions
examples.scope: Source corpus test-document title excerpt. This is an annotation task, not an author-written LLM prompt.
examples.prompt: Genetic mapping of the copper toxicosis locus in Bedlington terriers to dog chromosome 10, in a region syntenic to human chromosome region 2p13-p16.
examples.output: Identify disease mention spans. Offsets in this preview are zero-based and end-exclusive, relative to the title.
examples.grading: BLURB uses entity-level F1 for disease mentions. The reference also preserves source mention types and concept IDs as metadata; concept normalization is not part of this BLURB score.
